extracted.intended_audience: prospective American Mathematical Society members and customers ordering AMS publications (1996)
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and eligibility rules for applying to AMS membership and for ordering AMS/Elsevier publications, including membership categories, dues, verification requirements, payment and mailing procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ordinary member dues (income-based)
rubrics_metrics.description: For ordinary members whose annual professional income is below $45,000, the dues are $90; for those whose annual professional income is $45,000 or more, the dues are $120.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should choose ordinary member status and indicate income level to determine the correct dues rate.

rubrics_metrics.name: CMS cooperative rate (eligibility and dues)
rubrics_metrics.description: The CMS cooperative rate applies to ordinary members of the AMS who are also members of the Canadian Mathematical Society and reside outside of the U.S. For members whose annual professional income is $45,000 or less, the dues are $77; for those whose annual professional income is above $45,000, the dues are $102.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must be ordinary AMS member AND a member of the Canadian Mathematical Society and reside outside the U.S. to use this rate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Joint family membership rules and privileges
rubrics_metrics.description: For a joint family membership, one member pays ordinary dues based on his or her income; the other pays ordinary dues based on his or her income, less $20.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only the member paying full dues will receive the Notices and the Bulletin as a privilege of membership; both members will be accorded all other privileges of membership.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contributing member minimum dues
rubrics_metrics.description: Minimum dues for contributing members are $180.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contributing members must pay at least the stated minimum.

rubrics_metrics.name: Student and unemployed member dues and annual verification
rubrics_metrics.description: For either students or unemployed individuals, dues are $30, and annual verification is required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Students must provide student verification (signature and institution) indicating full-time status and working toward a degree. Unemployed applicants must sign an unemployed verification statement affirming active job-seeking and that unemployment is not due to voluntary resignation or retirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reciprocity membership eligibility and dues
rubrics_metrics.description: The annual dues for reciprocity members who reside outside the U.S. and Canada are $60. To be eligible for this classification, members must belong to one of those foreign societies with which the AMS has established a reciprocity agreement, and annual verification is required. Reciprocity members who reside in the U.S. or Canada must pay ordinary member dues ($90 or $120).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must sign a reciprocity membership verification confirming current membership in the indicated foreign society.

rubrics_metrics.name: Category-S members (developing countries) rules
rubrics_metrics.description: The annual dues for category-S members, those who reside in developing countries, are $16.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category-S members can choose only one privilege journal. The application form includes options to indicate which journal (e.g., send NOTICES or send BULLETIN).

rubrics_metrics.name: Multi-year membership option and exclusions
rubrics_metrics.description: Members can purchase a multi-year membership by prepaying their current dues rate for either two, three, four or five years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This option is not available to category-S, unemployed, or student members.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment methods and mailing addresses for AMS fees
rubrics_metrics.description: All payments must be in U.S. funds. Send checks, money orders, UNESCO coupons to American Mathematical Society, P.O. Box 5904, Boston, MA 02206-5904. To use credit cards, fill in information requested and mail to American Mathematical Society, P.O. Box 6248, Providence, RI 02940-6248 or call (401) 455-4000 or 1-800-321-4AMS.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For foreign bank transfers: the AMS bank is State Street Bank and Trust Company, 225 Franklin St., ABA #011000028, Account #0128-262-3, Boston, MA 02110. Include requested card/account details or contact numbers when paying by card.

rubrics_metrics.name: Shipping and handling charges for AMS orders
rubrics_metrics.description: Shipping and Handling: $3.00 per order. For optional delivery by air to foreign addresses: $6.50 per copy. Residents of Canada, please include 7% GST.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Customers ordering publications should add these charges to total amount; air delivery fees are per copy. Other delivery rates (e.g., air for journals/back volumes) may be quoted separately.

rubrics_metrics.name: EU VAT and currency statement for Elsevier orders
rubrics_metrics.description: Currencies other than US$ are definitive. US$ prices are valid in The Americas only. If you are a resident of the European Union you should either state your Value Added Tax (VAT) number or add the relevant VAT percentage applicable in your country to the total amount.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide VAT number to avoid adding VAT; prices subject to change without prior notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Elsevier/Publisher ordering and payment options
rubrics_metrics.description: Elsevier Science order form: payment options include cheque, UNESCO coupons, American Express, Eurocard/Mastercard/Access, Visa. If full payment is sent with order, Elsevier will pay postage and handling charges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Credit card information (card number and expiry) must be supplied; a proforma invoice can be requested. Different regional customer service addresses/contacts provided for Amsterdam, New York, Tokyo.

rubrics_metrics.name: Address change and mailing-list timing requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Members who move or change positions are urged to notify the Providence Office as soon as possible. Journal mailing lists must be printed four to six weeks before the issue date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To avoid disruption of service, supply new address information well in advance (two or three months) if changes are expected. Provide employer/location details if mailing address differs from employer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Membership record information and updates
rubrics_metrics.description: The Society's records contain information about members' positions and employers, honors, awards, and Society service. Records are valuable only to the extent that they are current and accurate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Members should supply requested information (new position, employer, telephone, e-mail) promptly to Customer Services (P.O. Box 6248, Providence, RI 02940 or e-mail amsmem@math.ams.org or cust-serv@math.ams.org).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reciprocal/distributor ordering instructions by region
rubrics_metrics.description: Customers in specified areas should request price information and order directly from the indicated distributors: Europe/Middle East/Africa: Oxford University Press (exclusive distributor of AMS books); India: International Book Agency; Japan: Maruzen Co. Ltd.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact regional distributor (address/telephone/fax) for pricing and ordering when indicated; distributor list clarifies where to place orders for different regions.
